title: Evidence prune does not restore partial removal
symptom: A failed observation unlink after artifact removal leaves the artifact missing
trigger: chough evidence prune --apply when the evidence directory rejects the observation rename
expected: Restore the artifact with original bytes and permissions and append a restored event
actual: The artifact stays deleted and only the initial prune ledger line exists
steps: Make the evidence directory read-only and run evidence prune --apply
impact: A refused apply destroys uncommitted evidence

notes.text: status: open -> verified. The real CLI regression now restores exact bytes and permissions and leaves no hold

status: verified -> open. Finish review found an in-scope restore publication race: after create_new/write, a concurrent replacement receives the original chmod. Deterministic failure checks replacement mode, inode and bytes plus preserved original recovery bytes.
